{{Top|leg}}
'''Loquasin''' was a powerful drug used in interrogations. It compelled the victim to talk, but the drug alone couldn't force the victim to reveal anything specific&mdash;she or he could still talk, or even sing, about something else. Apparently, it was harder for the victim not to break if the drug was combined with [[Torture/Legends|torture]].
